How projections work

Built to teach clearly, not to promise outcomes.

Plainvest uses simplified long-run assumptions so beginners can compare paths quickly. It shows direction, trade-offs, and inflation impact in plain terms.

Average annual return assumptions are used for each path.
Results compound monthly, but do not guarantee future market performance.
Taxes, fees, and personal circumstances can change real-life outcomes.

The silent thief
Your money is losing value
right now, while you sleep.

Inflation doesn't announce itself. It quietly erodes the buying power of every dollar sitting in a savings account. $100,000 today may only feel like $60,000 in 20 years — unless your money grows faster than rising prices.

$100,000
today's value
→
~$54,000
real buying power in 20 years
at ~3.3% average annual inflation
Purchasing power over a 30-year horizon

Compare how the same amount behaves in savings, invested growth, and real buying power after inflation.

What inflation means

Inflation is the rise in everyday prices over time, so the same cash buys less each year unless it grows faster than prices.

Plainvest uses adjustable average inflation assumptions for education. Official inflation is usually updated monthly or quarterly, not live every second, so you can change the percentage to test different scenarios.

The silent cost

Doing nothing
is still a financial decision.

Every year your money sits in a low-interest account while inflation runs above it, you lose real purchasing power — silently, automatically, without a single transaction.

10 years
~26% purchasing power lost
20 years
~45% purchasing power lost

The best protection against inflation is growth. Even a simple index fund has historically returned far more than inflation over the long term.

Our story
"
I didn't have this tool when I started. I wish I had — and that's exactly why I built it.

When I first got curious about investing, every resource I found was built for people who already knew what they were doing. I felt like this was a world reserved for the wealthy, the educated, or the financially gifted — not someone like me.

What I wished for was something simple — something visual that could show me, in plain numbers, what $100 a month actually becomes in 10 years. Not theory. Just: here's what's possible.

Investing is not gambling.
Doing nothing is.

Plainvest exists for every person who ever thought "I'll figure it out later." You don't need a finance degree. You don't need thousands in the bank. You just need to see what's possible.

EF
Eduardo Fogaça, founder
Building Plainvest for investors in Australia, Brazil, and the USA — from the beginner questions I wish someone had answered earlier.

Your transformation reading path
Books that change how you think about money.

Most people consume random finance content for years and still feel confused. One great book, understood deeply, changes more than 500 social media posts. We built a different path.

✓ Start here
Plainvest pick
The Little Book of Common Sense Investing
John C. Bogle

This book removes the fear that investing is too complicated. After reading it, you'll know why a simple index fund beats most experts — with proof, not promises.

⭐ #1 for beginners
What most beginners get wrong

"I'll just watch videos until it clicks."

Most people consume random finance content for years and still feel confused. One great book understood deeply is more powerful than 500 short videos.

Random content creates random knowledge — not a framework.
One book read slowly beats ten books skimmed fast.
A clear path from beginner to confident investor exists. This is it.
The Psychology of Money
Morgan Housel

Removes guilt and confusion by showing wealth is about behaviour, not math. You'll stop blaming yourself for past money mistakes.

⭐ Most recommended
Rich Dad Poor Dad
Robert T. Kiyosaki

Shifts how you see every purchase — from 'can I afford it?' to 'does this build wealth?' One mental model that changes everything after.

🧠 Mindset shift
A Random Walk Down Wall Street
Burton G. Malkiel

Builds evidence-based confidence. You'll understand exactly why diversification works and stop second-guessing your portfolio.

📊 Evidence-based
I Will Teach You to Be Rich
Ramit Sethi

Gives you a 6-week plan to automate your money so it works without willpower. You stop overthinking and start actually investing.

⚡ Action-focused
The Intelligent Investor
Benjamin Graham

Gives you the analytical framework to think like an investor, not a gambler. You'll learn to love boring, disciplined investing.

🏛️ The classic
The Black Swan
Nassim Nicholas Taleb

Teaches you to stop trusting models and start preparing for what you can't predict. Makes you a calmer investor when markets surprise everyone.

🧩 Macro & risk

What's the difference between the plans?

The Future Membership is a live dashboard — portfolio tracking, future projections, Freedom Score™, and AI insights that evolve each month. The Clarity Pass is educational: structured guides, Bitcoin clarity, and a Zoom onboarding call. Yours forever.

Do I need the subscription to access the guides?

No. The Clarity Pass gives you permanent access to the entire educational library with no monthly fee. The subscription adds live tracking and portfolio tools on top.

Can I upgrade from the Clarity Pass later?

Yes. Start with the Clarity Pass and move into the Future Membership anytime. Your educational content stays accessible regardless of which plan you're on.

What happens if I cancel the Future Membership?

Your dashboard access pauses, but your account stays active and you can return anytime. You won't lose your data.

Is this financial advice?

No. Plainvest is education and simulation. It helps you understand options and questions to ask — not what to buy or sell.

Is the Clarity Pass price final?

AUD $89.90 is the founding price. It will increase as Plainvest grows. Early members keep their price permanently.

How do I access content after purchasing?

Create your member account, complete Stripe checkout, and your guides unlock immediately inside the member hub.

Can I get a refund?

If something is wrong or you purchased by mistake, contact us within 7 days. We review fairly and your Australian Consumer Law rights apply.

Cancel anytime. 7-day review policy if something is not right.

The ideas behind long-term freedom
Books that change how you think about money.

A 5-stage reading journey — from understanding money to financial independence. Each book listed with what it actually changes in how you think.

Stage 1 Understanding Money
MindsetThe Psychology of MoneyMorgan Housel
Mindset

The Psychology of Money

Morgan Housel

Removes guilt and confusion by showing wealth is about behaviour, not math. You'll stop blaming yourself for past money mistakes after reading this.
